title: SpecMaker System Composition
description: A System Composition models a MULTI-LAYER system: a supersystem composed of member subsystems (and, recursively, nested sub-compositions). It is a SEPARATE document type from a Spec (spec.schema.json): a Spec describes ONE codebase and is the DSL's only RBAC root, so each member system stays a standalone, independently valid *.spec.json. A composition adds no per-system content — it only names the members, points at each member's document by relative path, and optionally records supersystem-level edges between them. A single-system model needs no composition document at all; author one Spec and stop.

kind.description: Free-text classifier for this layer, e.g. "supersystem", "platform", "product". Documentation only; the schema does not invent an enum.

MemberSystem.description: One member of this composition. A member is EITHER a leaf system (references a Spec document via `spec_path`) OR a nested composition (references another composition document via `composition_path`) — exactly one of the two, enforced with oneOf. Nesting via `composition_path` is what makes an N-layer (supersystem → subsystem → sub-subsystem) model possible without changing the schema.

role.description: Free-text role hint for this member, e.g. "subsystem", "shared-kernel", "gateway". Documentation only.

spec_path.description: Relative path (from this composition document) to the member's Spec document — a leaf system, validating against spec.schema.json.

composition_path.description: Relative path (from this composition document) to a nested composition document, validating against composition.schema.json. Use instead of spec_path when the member is itself a multi-layer system.

SystemRelationship.description: A supersystem-level edge between two member systems of this composition (e.g. one subsystem calls another's public API, or publishes an event the other consumes). Cross-system wiring the individual Specs cannot express because it lives above any one of them.

kind.description: Free-text edge kind, e.g. "calls_public_api", "publishes_event_to", "shares_database_with", "depends_on". Documentation only; the schema does not invent an enum.
